name: Ray-Cast Style Voxel Filling
definition: An algorithm to fill the interior of a mesh by scanning along the Z-axis, identifying intervals between front-facing and back-facing surface voxels and marking them as filled.
summary: Ray-Cast Style Voxel Filling determines interior voxels by casting Z-axis rays and marking solid cells upon outward-facing triangle intersections, differing from flood-fill methods by using deterministic geometric tests.
